public_body: Fall River City Council Committee On Finance
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the November 20, 2020 minutes, which listed all five members and recorded each vote as "5 yeas" or "4 yeas, 1 nay" with the dissenter named, adequately recorded the roll call votes, though the AG reiterated that minutes should list each member's vote by name.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee's November 20, 2020 remote meeting minutes failed to record the roll call votes taken during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: However, in this instance, we find that the combination of listing the five Committee members present at the meeting, combined with the statement “5 yeas” or “4 yeas, 1 nay” with the name of the Committee member voting in the negative, clearly and accurately recorded the roll call vote of each Committee member.
